title: Ticker list
statementMd:
List every ticker symbol with its company and sector.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `company`, `sector`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT symbol, company, sector FROM tickers;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
